metadata.experiment: Fixed-Q paired mode-ordering benchmark with TTpy DMRG-cross
metadata.Q_generation: Two 10x10 symmetric blocks. Each diagonal and lower-triangular entry is an independent N(0,1) draw; lower entries are mirrored. Off-block entries are zero.

ttpy_dmrg_settings.inaccurate_candidate_policy: Exclude after deterministic retries; greedy retains its current valid ordering if no insertion candidate passes, and beam stops expanding if no candidate passes.
ttpy_dmrg_settings.seed_strategy: Stable BLAKE2b-derived base seed from trial ID and candidate ordering, then consecutive uint32 seeds on retry; the same candidate ordering uses the same sequence in both methods.
